name: smwmusic-pok-mon-gold-silver-crystal-s-s-aqua-arrangement
title: Pokémon Gold/Silver/Crystal - S.S. Aqua (arrangement)
description:
A music to be played in cruise ships and holiday resorts. Alternatively can find an use in beaches, bonus levels and overworlds.

Extra credit may go to vgmusic.com user "Joo *Johnnyz* Buaes" since the midi he sequenced is of particularly good quality.

I've found Pokémon Gen. I and II music are a bit lacking in the music section. If you like what to hear, feel free to dm me a request.
